list.name: source
list.label: Baza
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT source AS __value, source_name AS __text FROM sessions ORDER BY source_name

list.name: session
list.label: Sesja
list.query: SELECT session_id AS __value, 'Sesja ' || session_id || ' (' || datetime(started_at, 'unixepoch', 'localtime') || ')' AS __text FROM sessions WHERE source = '${source}' ORDER BY session_id DESC

list.name: session_from
list.query: SELECT CAST((first_at) * 1000 AS INTEGER) FROM sessions WHERE source = '${source}' AND session_id = $session

list.name: session_to
list.query: SELECT CAST((last_at) * 1000 AS INTEGER) + 1 FROM sessions WHERE source = '${source}' AND session_id = $session

list.name: variant
list.label: Wariant przygotowania
list.query: SELECT variant AS __value, variant || ' – ' || description AS __text FROM variants ORDER BY current DESC, variant

list.name: pin
list.label: Piny
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT pin FROM signal_events WHERE variant = '${variant}' AND source = '${source}' AND session_id = $session ORDER BY pin

panels.title: Sesje (klik w numer sesji: wybór sesji i jej zakresu czasu)

targets.queryText:
SELECT session_id AS sesja, first_at AS od, last_at AS do,
  printf('%.1f h', (last_at - first_at) / 3600.0) AS czas,
  weight_count AS wskazania, pin_count AS "zmiany pinów", temperature_count AS temperatury,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM signal_events e WHERE e.variant = '${variant}' AND e.source = s.source AND e.session_id = s.session_id AND e.rejected = 0) AS zdarzenia,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM signal_events e WHERE e.variant = '${variant}' AND e.source = s.source AND e.session_id = s.session_id AND e.rejected = 1) AS odrzucone,
  CAST(first_at * 1000 AS INTEGER) AS from_ms, CAST(last_at * 1000 AS INTEGER) + 1 AS to_ms
FROM sessions s
WHERE source = '${source}' AND first_at IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY session_id
targets.rawQueryText:
SELECT session_id AS sesja, first_at AS od, last_at AS do,
  printf('%.1f h', (last_at - first_at) / 3600.0) AS czas,
  weight_count AS wskazania, pin_count AS "zmiany pinów", temperature_count AS temperatury,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM signal_events e WHERE e.variant = '${variant}' AND e.source = s.source AND e.session_id = s.session_id AND e.rejected = 0) AS zdarzenia,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM signal_events e WHERE e.variant = '${variant}' AND e.source = s.source AND e.session_id = s.session_id AND e.rejected = 1) AS odrzucone,
  CAST(first_at * 1000 AS INTEGER) AS from_ms, CAST(last_at * 1000 AS INTEGER) + 1 AS to_ms
FROM sessions s
WHERE source = '${source}' AND first_at IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY session_id

targets.queryText:
WITH b AS (SELECT MAX(1.0, $__interval_ms / 1000.0) AS s)
SELECT CAST(timestamp / b.s AS INTEGER) * b.s AS time, MIN(value) AS min, MAX(value) AS max
FROM weight, b
WHERE source = '${source}' AND session_id = $session AND timestamp >= (${__from} / 1000.0) AND timestamp < (${__to} / 1000.0)
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1
targets.rawQueryText:
WITH b AS (SELECT MAX(1.0, $__interval_ms / 1000.0) AS s)

FROM weight, b
WHERE source = '${source}' AND session_id = $session AND timestamp >= (${__from} / 1000.0) AND timestamp < (${__to} / 1000.0)
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Sygnały po obróbce (zielone: zdarzenie, czerwone: odrzucone)

targets.queryText:
WITH s AS (
  SELECT pin, timestamp, state FROM signal_changes
  WHERE variant = '${variant}' AND source = '${source}' AND session_id = $session AND kind = 'zdarzenia' AND pin IN (${pin:csv})
),
before AS (
  SELECT pin, state, MAX(timestamp) FROM s WHERE timestamp < (${__from} / 1000.0) GROUP BY pin
),
inside AS (
  SELECT timestamp AS time, pin, state FROM s WHERE timestamp >= (${__from} / 1000.0) AND timestamp < (${__to} / 1000.0)
),
last AS (
  SELECT pin, state FROM (
    SELECT pin, state, MAX(time) FROM (SELECT (${__from} / 1000.0) AS time, pin, state FROM before UNION ALL SELECT time, pin, state FROM inside)
    GROUP BY pin
  )
)
SELECT time, 'pin ' || pin || COALESCE(' (' || (SELECT role FROM signal_events e WHERE e.pin = u.pin AND e.role != '' LIMIT 1) || ')', '') AS metric, state AS value FROM (
  SELECT (${__from} / 1000.0) AS time, pin, state FROM before
  UNION ALL SELECT time, pin, state FROM inside
  UNION ALL SELECT (${__to} / 1000.0) AS time, pin, state FROM last
) u
ORDER BY time, metric
targets.rawQueryText:
WITH s AS (
  SELECT pin, timestamp, state FROM signal_changes
  WHERE variant = '${variant}' AND source = '${source}' AND session_id = $session AND kind = 'zdarzenia' AND pin IN (${pin:csv})
),
before AS (
  SELECT pin, state, MAX(timestamp) FROM s WHERE timestamp < (${__from} / 1000.0) GROUP BY pin
),
inside AS (
  SELECT timestamp AS time, pin, state FROM s WHERE timestamp >= (${__from} / 1000.0) AND timestamp < (${__to} / 1000.0)
),
last AS (
  SELECT pin, state FROM (
    SELECT pin, state, MAX(time) FROM (SELECT (${__from} / 1000.0) AS time, pin, state FROM before UNION ALL SELECT time, pin, state FROM inside)
    GROUP BY pin
  )
)
SELECT time, 'pin ' || pin || COALESCE(' (' || (SELECT role FROM signal_events e WHERE e.pin = u.pin AND e.role != '' LIMIT 1) || ')', '') AS metric, state AS value FROM (
  SELECT (${__from} / 1000.0) AS time, pin, state FROM before
  UNION ALL SELECT time, pin, state FROM inside
  UNION ALL SELECT (${__to} / 1000.0) AS time, pin, state FROM last
) u
ORDER BY time, metric

panels.title: Zdarzenia w widocznym zakresie (klik w początek: przybliż ±30 s)

targets.queryText:
SELECT 'pin ' || pin || CASE WHEN role != '' THEN ' (' || role || ')' ELSE '' END AS sygnał,
  start AS początek, end AS koniec, round(duration, 2) AS "czas [s]", pulse_count AS impulsy,
  round(active_share, 2) AS "udział aktywnego", CASE WHEN rejected = 1 THEN 'odrzucone' ELSE 'przyjęte' END AS status,
  CAST((start - 30) * 1000 AS INTEGER) AS from_ms, CAST((end + 30) * 1000 AS INTEGER) AS to_ms
FROM signal_events
WHERE variant = '${variant}' AND source = '${source}' AND session_id = $session AND pin IN (${pin:csv})
  AND start < (${__to} / 1000.0) AND end >= (${__from} / 1000.0)
ORDER BY start
targets.rawQueryText:
SELECT 'pin ' || pin || CASE WHEN role != '' THEN ' (' || role || ')' ELSE '' END AS sygnał,
  start AS początek, end AS koniec, round(duration, 2) AS "czas [s]", pulse_count AS impulsy,
  round(active_share, 2) AS "udział aktywnego", CASE WHEN rejected = 1 THEN 'odrzucone' ELSE 'przyjęte' END AS status,
  CAST((start - 30) * 1000 AS INTEGER) AS from_ms, CAST((end + 30) * 1000 AS INTEGER) AS to_ms
FROM signal_events
WHERE variant = '${variant}' AND source = '${source}' AND session_id = $session AND pin IN (${pin:csv})
  AND start < (${__to} / 1000.0) AND end >= (${__from} / 1000.0)
ORDER BY start

targets.queryText:
WITH b AS (SELECT MAX(1.0, $__interval_ms / 1000.0) AS s)
SELECT CAST(timestamp / b.s AS INTEGER) * b.s AS time, '…' || substr(sensor_address, -4) AS metric, AVG(value) AS value
FROM temperatures, b
WHERE source = '${source}' AND session_id = $session AND timestamp >= (${__from} / 1000.0) AND timestamp < (${__to} / 1000.0)
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1
